voice.text: The wolf moves. [pause] The river moves. [pause] Which one is alive? Tap your guess.

<emphasis>Living things need food and water.</emphasis> [pause] The wolf eats, and drinks from the stream.
<emphasis>Living things move on their own.</emphasis> [pause] Nobody pushes the wolf. She runs all by herself.
<emphasis>Living things make more of their kind.</emphasis> [pause] The wolf has pups!
Now, the river. [pause] It moves. [pause] But does it grow? No. Does it eat or drink? No. Does it have babies? [pause] No! [pause] Moving is not enough. The river is <emphasis>not</emphasis> living.
Your turn! Drag each card to Living, or Not living. [pause] Or tap a button.
All sorted! [pause] Now show what you know.

A wolf runs through the woods. Living, or not living?
A river rushes downhill all day. Living, or not living?
An oak tree stands still all winter. Living, or not living?
A log on the ground. Living, or not living?
